_meta.scope: Candidate pool, directions, family-internal priorities, global order, emission factors, thresholds. Frozen at the Part-A freeze commit BEFORE A3 and before any wave-D or prompt-52 number. Any later change is an AMENDMENT with disclosure.
_meta.delta_convention: value(run) - value(base_2019_v2:1); the three base runs are byte-identical
seen_before_pinning: the 31 v2 runs' legacy 9 columns (objectives_t1_v2.csv machinery)
base-run values of N1/N3/N4/N5/E7 and the uplift zeros
the n = 16 first cut of relief/var_cost/h2/starts (pool_correlations.csv)

family_order_note: Global tie-break (ii): V < E < X < R < N. D (H2 diagnostics) can never survive a cluster and is listed last.
global_order_rule: (i) lower family-internal priority; (ii) on a tie, family order V < E < X < R < N; (iii) on a remaining tie, the lower id number. Candidates with no priority (dir '-' and no rank) are appended in family-then-id order and can never survive a cluster.
survivor_rule: The cluster survivor is the first member in global_order that has a declared min/max direction and a step-1 status that is neither UNREADABLE nor DEAD. If no member qualifies, the cluster is reported with no survivor.
E1_handover: If plan ERCOT_BO_PLAN.md section 1.2 FAILS, E1 is REMOVED before Part-B step 3 and E3 takes priority 1 in family E (E3 then precedes E4).

V1.name: true curtailment
V1.formula: sum of gen_summary.curtailment_mwh over rows with is_pem == False and unit_type in {WIND, PV} (== compute_objectives.metrics true_curt)

V3.name: PEM-twin delivered share
V3.formula: sum(gen_summary.output_mwh | is_pem) / sum(gen_summary.output_mwh + gen_summary.curtailment_mwh | is_pem == False and unit_type in {WIND, PV})

E1.name: total cost
E1.note: objective if plan 1.2 passes; see E1_handover

E5.name: uplift payments
E5.note: expected DEAD (0 on all 31 v2 runs); asserted in A2, kept in the dead list

E6.name: VRE energy payments
E6.formula: sum over days of daily_summary['Renewables energy payments']

E7.name: mean settlement price (energy)
E7.note: NOT overall['Cumulative average price'], which is cost per MWh (E1 / demand) and never a price

E8.name: LMP dispersion
E8.formula: standard deviation (ddof = 1) over all (bus, hour) rows of bus_lmps['LMP'] (real-time)
E8.slim_companion: E8_slim_daily_settle_sd = standard deviation over days of daily_summary['Total energy payments'] / daily_summary['Demand']; reported alongside, never substituted

E9.name: scarcity bus-hours
E9.formula: count of (bus, hour) rows with bus_lmps['LMP'] >= lmp_scarcity_threshold

N4.name: pocket-120 congested line-hours
N4.formula: sum of line_summary['hours_ge_99pct'] over the branches with From Bus == 120 or To Bus == 120 in branch.csv; per-line split in N4_<UID> columns

N5.name: congestion spread
N5.formula: mean over hours t of ( LMP[t, bus_name(120)] - sum_b LMP[t,b] * L[t,b] / sum_b L[t,b] ); bus_name(120) from bus.csv 'Bus ID' -> 'Bus Name' (= 'Knox City 345'); L[t,b] = REAL_TIME_load.csv column str(b) (Area == Bus ID), joined on (Date, Hour) with Hour = Period - 1, year-end padding dropped by the join. NEVER weighted by bus.csv['MW Load'].
N5.check_column: N5_unweighted_check = the same with equal bus weights (base reference -17.36 $/MWh, seen before pinning)

X1.name: CO2 (fuel-factor)
X1.formula: sum over gen_summary rows with is_pem == False of output_mwh * EF[unit_type]

D1.name: H2 electricity
D1.formula: compute_objectives h2: twin curtailment (sum gen_summary.curtailment_mwh | is_pem) for VRE designs; thermal rule compute_objectives.thermal_h2 (sum over committed hours of pmax - Dispatch) for nuclear designs; copied from the frozen objectives_t1_v2.csv with h2_source = frozen_t1_v2 when thermal.csv.gz is absent
D1.role: diagnostic (RTS convention); enters M only by PI adoption (D5)

D2.name: PEM utilization
D2.formula: D1 / (pem_mw * 8760); pem_mw = omega * gen_pmax from the wave design matrix, or sum of PEM_fraction * gen_pmax over retrofit_gen_dict_<index>.json for the __ALL__ row; NEVER gen_summary.pmax_mw

emission_factors_t_per_mwh.sensitivity: plus/minus 20 percent (x0.8 / x1.2), all factors together (X1_ef_lo/hi) and gas only (X1_gas_lo/hi)
source: Fuel CO2 factors: US EPA, 40 CFR Part 98 Subpart C, Table C-1 (natural gas 53.06 kg CO2/MMBtu; bituminous coal 93.28 kg CO2/MMBtu).

Fleet heat rates: US EIA, Electric Power Annual, Table 8.2 'Average tested heat rates by prime mover and energy source' (coal steam about 10,400 Btu/kWh; natural-gas simple-cycle gas turbine about 11,000 Btu/kWh). 93.28 x 10.4 = 0.97 t/MWh -> pinned 1.00; 53.06 x 11.0 = 0.58 t/MWh -> pinned 0.55 (a combined-cycle fleet would be about 0.40).

Cross-check: US EIA FAQ 'How much carbon dioxide is produced per kilowatthour of U.S. electricity generation?' (2022: coal 2.30 lb/kWh = 1.04 t/MWh; natural gas 0.97 lb/kWh = 0.44 t/MWh fleet average incl. combined cycle).
emission_factors_t_per_mwh.disclosure: Heat rates CANNOT come from v2 gen.csv: its HR columns are synthetic (cost / fuel price, prompt 36). All 113 gas units are typed CT with generic peaker-like heat rates (fuelmix-check 2026-10-15), so the gas factor is a disclosed approximation. The executor cited the tables above from the public documents named; the numbers were not re-fetched in the executor session.
emission_factors_t_per_mwh.expectation_pinned: X1 is expected to CONFLICT with E1 (coal C1 $18.5-19.8/MWh < all gas C1 $23.4-57/MWh in the v2 dataset: cheaper = more coal).

thresholds.lmp_scarcity_threshold_note: 0.9 x price_threshold 500 $/MWh; real-time LMP from bus_lmps.csv.gz
thresholds.suspect_S2: every RUC status == OPTIMAL in ruc_quality.csv
thresholds.suspect_S3: non-nuclear designs: starts of units 1 and 93 == 0; any design: starts of units 1 and 93 equal across exact replicates
thresholds.dead_rule: zero variance of the raw value over the 31 v2 runs (max == min exactly); evidence = max |value|

mip_gap_bound.G_run: sum over RUC days of final_gap_pct / 100 * ruc_cost (ruc_quality.csv)
mip_gap_bound.disclosure: ruc_cost is the RUC objective (day-ahead commitment + dispatch cost), not the realized total cost; G is an approximate bound. No gap bound exists for settlement quantities (E4, E6) and none is claimed.

scale_free_S.formula: S_jl = range_jl / mean over the 6 VRE sites of |delta_jl| at MW level l; undefined (NO EFFECT AT THIS LEVEL) when the mean is 0
scale_free_S.size_driven: S_jl < 0.5 at >= 2 of 3 levels with a nonzero mean
scale_free_S.first_cut_use: printed on the 16-row first cut as a descriptor only (NON-USE clause)

perturbation_ruler.definition: ruler_j = median |delta_j| over the prompt-52 perturbed copies (delta = 0.001 relative; 4 designs x 2 copies = 8 values)
perturbation_ruler.readable_wording: exceeds twice the median response to a 0.1 % input perturbation at the prompt-52 designs
perturbation_ruler.fail_wording: not readable above the perturbation response
perturbation_ruler.ruler_zero: RULER=0: readable iff |delta_j| >= 1 natural unit (1 start, 1 line, 1 bus-hour, 1 MWh); continuous candidates report raw delta with the tag
perturbation_ruler.unavailable: RULER UNAVAILABLE for E8/E9/N5 if the 52 extracts are slim
perturbation_ruler.pending: RULER PENDING (52) on every Part-B readability statement until 52 lands

location_verdict.location_sensitive: range_jl >= 2 x ruler_j at >= 2 of 3 levels
location_verdict.location_insensitive_at_these_sizes: per-site |delta_jl| >= 2 x ruler_j for >= 4 of 6 sites at >= 2 levels AND range_jl < 2 x ruler_j at >= 2 levels
location_verdict.kendall_W: descriptor only; exact permutation p (k = 6 sites, n = 3 level blocks)

redundancy.orientation: max candidates x (-1); '-' candidates shown, never clustered, never survive
redundancy.redundant_pair: rho_or >= +0.90 on the pooled 18-row matrix AND rho_or >= +0.90 at >= 2 of the 3 per-level matrices (n = 6)
redundancy.trade_off_pair: rho_or <= -0.90 -> never a cluster; routed to the conflict check
redundancy.first_cut_A3: the same +0.90 complete-linkage rule names clusters on the 16-row first cut; it may not drop any member (NON-USE)

conflict.trade_off_size: pooled rho_or <= -0.50 and negative at >= 2 of 3 levels
conflict.trade_off_location: additionally rho_or <= -0.50 at >= 2 of 3 per-level matrices

recommendation_cap.rule: top 4 by global_order with at most one per family; the full survivor list is still shown

first_cut_rows.partial_convention: rank-residual partial Spearman on gen_pmax (pool_correlations.csv convention); no tie rule because the v2 ruler is 0
